basic_details.job_title: CSIR NEERI Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI) has notified 2 temporary vacancies for the Project Associate-I post. These positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the aforementioned projects. Eligible applicants must hold an M.Sc. / Integrated Masters in Environmental Science/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry from recognized University and be 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. The notified pay is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA or Rs. 25,000/- + HRA. Candidates can submit their online application form through the official website on or before 29.10.2026

age_limit.details: Upper Age Limit: 35 years. Upper age limit shall be reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.

vacancy_details.Vacancies: *Number of post :02 (*Anticipated vacancy for the post may be 04 nos. depending upon the availability of funds and the candidate will be selected from the waiting list)

how_to_apply: The last date of submission of online application form is 29.10.2026. Candidates are not required to pay any application fees.
important_instructions: The engagement in these projects will not confer any right implicit or explicit on the candidate for considering regularization against any CSIR/CSIR - NEERI post(s). Only those candidates who have acquired the essential qualification & result has been declared (should have at least provisional certificate) are eligible to apply for a particular position. Result awaited /Final semester appeared or Ph. D submitted candidates are not eligible to apply for the position where such minimum essential qualification requirement is mandatory. Final semester and result awaited candidates are not allowed to appear for the interview. Experience, where required, will be counted from the date after acquiring minimum educational qualification. Dissertation/ Thesis work done during academic period will not be counted as experience. Time spent in acquiring higher qualification will not be counted as an experience over essential qualification. Mere fulfilling of minimum qualification does not confer any right in a candidate for being called for interview. If large number of applications received, preference will be given to the candidates under the criteria adopted by the Screening Committee. The shortlisted candidates will be invited for the online interview, information will be uploaded on the website/ portal.(applicable only for online interview and not for walk in interview) No upgradation of the project staff shall be done in same or new project. However, candidates have to apply fresh, and if shortlisted, have to appear for the interview. CSIR-NEERI reserves the right to cancel or withdraw the offer of engagement in case of any discrepancy found, in the candidature of any empaneled candidate at any stage. The selected candidates are expected to join within time frame mentioned in the offer letter from the date of receiving offer letter of appointment, after completion of pre-appointment formalities like medical examination, character verification etc. Each selected candidate shall sign an undertaking for maintaining confidentiality of project findings and/or any associated intellectual property information. Engagement under the new project would be made only after the acceptance of the resignation from the previous project by the competent authority. Engagement of project staff will depend on the project tenure/ requirement, which may be extended or curtailed depending on the duration of the Project/desired level performance or conduct of the incumbent, as the case may be. The engagement of project staff may be terminated at any time without assigning any reasons, by giving a one-month notice. In case, the person desires to leave the assignment, he/she may also do so by giving one month notice or payment of one-month remuneration in lieu of, which can be condoned/ curtailed at the discretion of the Competent Authority. The project staff shall have to make their own arrangement for accommodation during their tenure in the project. However, HRA shall be admissible as per applicable rules. The offer letter shall be issued to the candidate initially for a period for which funds are available. A review committee will assess the performance of the project staff and recommend for their extension, if required, subject to the availability of funds in the project. CSIR guidelines for engagement of project personnel, as made applicable vide CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024/ 18.10.2024 and amended from time to time shall apply. No TA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the interview in case of offline interviews. Other terms & conditions will be governed as per guidelines issued by the funding agency/ CSIR-NEERI for the engagement of the Project Staff as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: About CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute, Nehru Marg, Nagpur 440 020. Application from eligible & interested candidates are invited for engagement of R & D project staff via ONLINEINTERVIEW for the following positions on purely temporary basis under the Project, “To develop a CO2-bio refinery by carbon capture from flue gas through medium large scale microbial biomass production as feedstock for biofuels and value added products - (GAP-3103)”, tenable at CSIR-NEERI Nagpur. Place of Posting: CSIR-NEERI, Nagpur.

rows.vacancies: *Number of post :02 (*Anticipated vacancy for the post may be 04 nos. depending upon the availability of funds and the candidate will be selected from the waiting list)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Knowledge of Algal Sequestration of CO2 Design of photo-bioreactors Technical Report and Scientific Article writing Knowledge of R-statistics or Python for Data analysis Upper Age Limit: 35 years. Upper age limit shall be reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. / Integrated Masters in Environmental Science/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry from recognized University

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Monthly Emoluments (in ₹): (a) Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for those candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET lectureship / Assistant professorship or GATE OR Those who have qualified National level examinations conducted by Central Government conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and / or their Agencies / Institutions. (b) Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others who do not fall under (a) above. The above positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the aforementioned projects. Moreover, under no circumstances the tenure of project staff who have served CSIR-NEERI or any other laboratories/Institutes of CSIR under contract R&D projects would be allowed to exceed Six or Seven as the case may be as per clause no. 1.6/1.7 of CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD Dated 02.09.2024 as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: The last date of submission of online application form is 29.10.2026. Candidates are not required to pay any application fees.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Mode of Selection: Selection will be done on the basis of Interview online (through MS Team/Skype/ etc.). Date of interview will be notified separately in www.neeri.res.in website.
